Help center is a JavaScript app (www.truist.com/help redirects to bank.truist.com/web/support) Cards: Enjoy Cash, Enjoy Travel, Enjoy Beyond, Future, secured. Former BB&T and SunTrust cardholders are now Truist. Https://www.truist.com/support  lists 'Personal credit card: 800-289-6385' and small business card 800-279-4481; general 844-4TRUIST (844-487-8478), +1-910-914-8250 outside the U.S. Consumer payment relief hub: https://www.truist.com/payment-relief/personal-loans. Personal credit card line: 800-289-6385; credit cards also at 844-4TRUIST (844-487-8478). Payment relief FAQ: https://www.truist.com/payment-relief/personal-loans/faq and options https://www.truist.com/payment-relief/personal-loans/relief-options. Contact page: credit card inquiries 844-4TRUIST (844-487-8478), Mon-Fri 8am-8pm, Sat 8am-5pm ET, Sunday automated only; Spanish option 9; outside U.S. +1-910-914-8250. Truist's 'Personal Loan Payment Relief Options' page  explicitly covers cards - it 'allows you to temporarily suspend your payments on your auto loan, personal credit card, or other personal loan'; the hub page (/payment-relief/personal-loans) likewise names credit cards. Apply in Online Banking (select the account > More > Payment Relief) Card pay/autopay/statement how-to pages are still not public. To pay a Truist credit card from a Truist account: mobile app > Transfer & pay > 'transfer money and pay Truist bills' > choose the account to pay, amount, submit. For paperless: Accounts > choose the account > Statements > Paperless preferences > enable Paperless (also where statements are viewed). These are generic (not card-specific) walkthroughs.
